name: 4-Digit 7-Segment LED Clock Display
description: 4-digit numeric LED display with central clock colon, controlled over a 2-wire serial protocol (CLK, DIO) using the TM1637 driver.
realWorldAnalogy: 4-digit numeric LED display with central clock colon, controlled over a 2-wire serial protocol (CLK, DIO) using the TM1637 driver.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC to 5V, GND to GND, CLK to Pin 2, and DIO to Pin 3. Install TM1637Display library in the Arduino IDE.
commonMistakes: Omitting the TM1637 library initialization parameters.

miniExperiment.title: Digital Counter
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, CLK to Pin 2, DIO to Pin 3.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The display rapidly counts from 0 up to 99 in glowing red numerals.
